description: Use this after you have processed a page from cooper_poll_events. Requires auth and message_read. Inputs: client_id (the consumer id or client_id) and cursor (the commit_cursor you received, an evc1 cursor). Returns the consumer. cursor on the response is the committed position. An older cursor is a no-op and the current position is returned. A value that is not an evc1 cursor is HTTP 400 invalid_cursor. Another account's consumer is HTTP 404 consumer_not_found.

client_id.description: Consumer id (evcon_…) or the client_id used when the consumer was created.

cursor.description: evc1 cursor to commit. An older cursor does not move the position backwards.

name: cooper_commit_events
title: Commit durable events
